purpose: Show ordered AI composition boundaries for a sourced island-platform station whose train is intended to arrive through a reviewed throat, stop at a platform face, depart and reach a downstream station.

execution_rules.plan_first: Compile the requirement with opentrack_compile_railway_plan and use that plan_id.

required_observations_separate_from_comp.assertion: arrival at IslandFaceB without passing the stop
Inspector route, signal and lamp checks

limitations: The symbolic bridge call stands for one dependency-ready step. Repeat that shape with the next compiled action and one reviewed writer named by it.
Every angle-bracket value and downstream ID must be resolved from a fresh project inspection.
The example is not a CompiledPlan object and cannot be passed directly to the publication gateway.
The reviewed writer must appear in the selected compiled action's implementation_tools.
A saved candidate establishes archive publication only. It does not establish an actual train run.
